import unittest
from tinyledger import store

class StoreTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_stores_cents(self):
        es = []
        store.add(es, '餐饮', '0.1')
        self.assertEqual(es[0]['amount_cents'], 10)

    def test_total_after_add(self):
        es = []
        store.add(es, '餐饮', '0.1')
        store.add(es, '餐饮', '0.2')
        self.assertEqual(store.total(es), 30)
